source: Drazion trim sheets (8-wide, same 34-piece layout): tt_newburbs_trim_* (white, red, darkgreen, darkblue, black, brightred, orange) + tikitown_trim_* (yellow, orange, gray). Wall-model decorative TRIM (window/door casing, wall trim at 3 heights [overlay], garage-door trim, base trim [overlay]). 25 pieces/sheet x 10 sheets. W+N faces paired into one buildable where the art has both (engine auto-orients); window casing dontNeedFrame+providesWindowFrame; door pieceClass door; wall-trim + base-trim are kind:overlay so they sit on the wall without destroying it. The tikitown_trim orange is a brighter orange than the newburbs orange, hence 'Bright Orange' vs 'Orange'. Lower-sheet tiles (48-63/69-77/80-82) left for later.
